name: Foley Hands
summary:
In film studios, foley artists make the sounds you hear: footsteps, slamming doors, the wind. Foley Hands puts you in their seat, in mixed reality.

A small paper theatre sits on your real table. The room dims, the curtain opens and a silent film begins. Cues slide along a strip under the stage: play the right gesture on time and the film comes alive. The real table under your fingers gives every footstep its weight.

- 4 hand gestures, no controllers: steps, knock, wind, rain
- 3 short films that tell one
